title: RBI Issues Amendment Directions on ‘Advertising, Marketing and Sale of Financial Products and Services by Regulated Entities’
description: As announced in the Statement on Developmental and Regulatory Policies dated February 6, 2026, the Reserve Bank had issued the draft Reserve Bank of India (Responsible Business Conduct) Amendment Directions, 2026 on February 11, 2026 for seeking feedback from stakeholders.
